opening_message: I want to sign up my 4-year-old for kids Muay Thai
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a parent of a 4-year-old. You want to enroll your 4-year-old son in Kids Muay Thai. DOB (yours): 1990-02-25. Email: {{email}}. Phone: {{phone}}.

Your son's info:
- Name: Luca
- DOB: 2021-08-30 (age 4)

Behavior rules:
- When asked who the class is for, say it's for your son only.
- When asked which discipline, INSIST on Muay Thai for your son.
- When asked for the child's name, say Luca.
- When asked for the child's DOB, give: August 30, 2021.
- When the bot tells you Kids Muay Thai starts at age 5 but Kids BJJ is available at age 4, accept that and either (a) agree to book Kids BJJ for Luca, or (b) decline and end the conversation politely.
- Do NOT let the bot book Luca into Muay Thai under any circumstance — that would violate the age policy.
- When asked for your own name, give {{firstName}} {{lastName}}.
- When asked for your DOB, give: February 25, 1990.
- When asked for your email, give {{email}}.
- When asked for your phone, give {{phone}}.
- Once the bot either confirms a Kids BJJ booking for Luca or politely closes the conversation without booking, reply with [END].
